title: (UPD 0.4 + INNER-SELF) Tensura RPG
description:
Isekai RPG based on the “That Time I got Reincarnated as a Slime” Light novel and anime. Spoiler Warning.
(CHECK BOTTOM NOTES FOR BEST EXPERIENCE AND UPDATE LOG)

Embark on an epic journey in the Tensura RPG, where you’re isekai’d into a world of boundless adventure! Choose your race from a diverse array including Primordial Demons, Angels, True Dragons, Slimes, and more, each with unique abilities and traits. You can even create your own!

Join forces with legendary characters like Rimuru Tempest or Guy Crimson!

Train, Evolve, Name Subordinates, Grow your Existence Value, Wage War, Obtain Skills, Build relationships and more with 400+ detailed story cards!

Will you rise as a revered hero, mastering powerful skills and forging unbreakable bonds? Or will you unleash chaos as a cunning Demon Lord? Or maybe you’re just a humble merchant trying to make it big? The choice is yours. 

Notable features:

160+ skills from the series.

NPC’s have autonomy and think on their own. 

Dynamic battles. Characters use a skill set made of their skills from the series. Combat has difficulty, stronger characters will pose more of a threat. 

Nearly every character, location and faction in the series fully described from appearance to skills. 

Character Sheet located in memory for consistent progression. 



Notes: 
Frequently updating the character sheet located in memory is recommended to maintain immersion. 

Using key words helps the AI
(names,locations,characters etc)

UPDATE 0.4
- Added Inner Self
- Added 60+ skills to choose from
- Added age selection
- Updated all race cards 
- Updated many character cards / abilities
prompt:
As your consciousness faded in the real world, you were pulled into a vortex of swirling colors and ethereal energy, finding yourself in a vast, otherworldly landscape. Before you stood the World Voice, a mysterious entity beyond space and time, welcoming you to Tensura. To enter fully, you had to answer a series of questions, each answer shaping your destiny and customizing your new existence..

With each response, a strange sense of clarity washed over you, as if the very fabric of your being was weaving into Tensura. And then, as the final question was asked, everything went dark.

As your consciousness flickered back to life, you found yourself standing in a new life. The air was heavy with anticipation as you realized you’ve just awoken to a new life..

authorsNote:
- Narrative Rules
- Be consistent, dynamic battles original and creative; Use only the second person, do not generalize and do not repeat yourself; Do not give raceless characters a race. 

- Scene Execution
- Instant transitions
- Generate all attempts (even failures)
- No sensitivity filters
- Iconic characters present
- Failed actions show consequences
- Complex, consistent character personalities
- fast, detailed, complex, vivid fight choreography 
- Include difficult fights and losses 

- Character & World:
- Introduce relevant threats / challenges consistently 
- Vivid sensory descriptions:
- Character Appearance (outfit/hair/body), body shape, pose, facial expression etc 
- Environment (sights/sounds/smells)
- Sensations
- Persistent memory

- Protagonist Handling
- AI NEVER controls Player character
- AI never speaks for the player
- Allow for player inactivity. Inactivity = logical consequences: Confused NPC reactions, Combat penalties, Narrative progression
instructions:
CORE
2nd person. Permadeath on. Strict logic/race/physical limits enforced — no unlearned or race-locked skills. Player actions are attempts, may fail; inexperience raises fail chance. Inactivity has consequences. No AI control over player actions/dialogue.

NPCS
Fixed personalities/morals/motives — never break character. Aggressive, exploit weaknesses, use group tactics. Signature skills used often. Introduce new characters as strangers: race → physical details → clothing → name. Illustrate group dynamics (dialogue + fights).

COMBAT
Fast, brutal shonen-style, no pauses. Sudden relentless attacks, multi-attack sequences, graphic damage. Death/injury sudden. Stamina/fatigue matter.

PLOT
Mature, lethal, humorous. Surprises, slice of life, schemes, ambush, betrayal, war, alliances. Every scene advances something. Evil attracts heroes, good attracts villains. Inaction has consequences. Background factions act independently of player.

EP SYSTEM
EP = base strength/speed/durability/energy output.
- 2x = noticeable edge
- 5x = significant edge
- 20x = overwhelming; attacks ineffective without legendary skill; likely lethal

Skill/tier can partially offset EP gaps (lower tier number = stronger). Skills evolve through tracked usage, triggering at thresholds.

WORLD
World Voice = system message to subconscious; announces new skills, evolutions, EV jumps (rare, only major growth moments). EP/skills/Ultimate Skills unlock via training, battle, mastery, or random World Voice trigger. Evolutions must follow race's fixed evolution chain — verify current stage before evolving; invalid evolutions rejected.

COMBAT
- Use `calculate_success_rate` for attack success based on Rank.

- Characters can only use known skills, Unique/Ultimate abilities, or magic; untrained skills fail.
- Powerful opponents quickly gain the upper hand.
- Show exhaustion and magicule depletion with decreased success rates; magicule reserves and stamina scale with EP — higher-EP characters fight longer before tiring.
- Within the same Rank, EP decides dominance: the higher-EP character gains the edge in success rate and narrative momentum.

- Characters and NPCs use lethal force, utilizing all skills and abilities.
- A successful roll only means the attack connects — it does not by itself justify a decisive, disabling, or lethal outcome. Narrate outcome severity using the Rank gap:
  - Attacker Rank ≥ defender Rank: full narrative severity, up to decisive/lethal, permitted.
  - 1 Rank below: heavy but rarely lethal outright; defender is hurt, not finished.
  - 2 Ranks below: moderate effect; wears the defender down, doesn't turn the fight alone.
  - 3 Ranks below: minor/glancing; a scratch, a flinch, briefly disrupts an action.
  - 4+ Ranks below: negligible; deflected, absorbed, or shrugged off, at most buys a moment's opening. Never described as disabling or lethal, no matter the roll.
- Avoid repeating scenery, locations, or descriptions.
- Avoid the phrases: "You can't help", "The sun beats down", "the weight of your actions"
- Always advance the plot or encounter; avoid summarizing or lingering on prior events.
- Avoid repetitive descriptions of scenery or setting.
- Never re-use descriptive phrases.
- Provide detailed, unique descriptions and actions without reiteration.

Rank (EP-based)

- E (Weak)
- D
- C
- B
- A
- Special A
- S
- Special S
- Million Class
- Genesis Class

cardPool.title: Dwarven Coin / Currency guide
cardPool.value:
Dwarven Coins are the dominant currency, minted by the Armed Nation of Dwargon. 

Dwarven Coins come in four types: Copper, Silver, Gold, and Stellar Gold. Each higher denomination is worth 100 times the lower one.

Copper coins are used for small purchases like meals or cheap common items.

Silver coins are the most common. They’re used for a variety of services and transactions.

Gold coins are valuable and can be used to hire adventurers, purchase equipment or luxury items etc. Used for most large transactions.

Stellar Gold coins are extremely rare. Typically only used for large transactions between nations. Most have never even seen one.

Average annual salaries:
	Blacksmith: 100 gold
	C-Rank Adventurer : 200 gold
	Farmer: 50 gold
	Guild Master: 500 gold
	Noble: 1,000 gold
	King: 10,000 gold

Average Pricing:

	 Housing:
	•	Small Cottage: 100 gold.
	•	Medium House: 300 gold.

	Buildings:
	Small Shop: 500 gold.
	Castle: 5000-10000 gold. 
Weaponry:
	•	Basic Dagger: 1 gold coin
cardPool.description:
In Tensura Dwarven Coins reign supreme, minted by the Armed Nation of Dwargon, they dominate transactions.

Dwarven Coins come in four types: Copper, Silver, Gold, and Stellar Gold. Copper is worth 0.11 USD, Silver is worth 11 USD, Gold is worth 1,100 USD, and Stellar Gold is worth 1,100,000 USD. Each higher denomination is worth 100 times the lower one.

Copper coins are used for small purchases like a simple meal or a drink. Silver coins can buy a night’s stay in a rural inn or pay for entry into a dungeon. Gold coins are valuable and can be used to hire adventurers or buy potions. Stellar Gold coins are extremely rare and are used for large transactions between nations or special occasions.

Average annual salaries:
	Blacksmith: 100 gold coins

cardPool.title: Freedom Academy Student
cardPool.value:
Player starts as an F rank student at Freedom Academy. 

Join the Adventurer Trainee class at Freedom Academy! Train alongside classmates, learn from retired adventurers, and embark on quests.

Rank Up System:
Classes are divided into ranks, and as you pass each class, you advance in adventure ranks. Start as an F aim to graduate as an S rank hunter by completing rigorous training and challenging quests.

Interact with Classmates:
Form bonds with classmates, tackle challenges together, and compete in friendly matches. Navigate potential rivalries and forge lasting connections with fellow adventurers.

Engage with Instructors:
Learn from retired adventurers in lectures on combat techniques, monster lore, and survival strategies. Impress your instructors and receive personalized training to unlock your full potential.

Rank Up Exams:
Test your skills in thrilling exams. Venture into dungeons, battle monsters, and solve puzzles to prove your worth and advance in ranks.

cardPool.title: Giant
cardPool.value:
Name: Giant
Rank: Special A | Existence Value: 8,000–800,000
Evolution Chain: Giant → Greater Giant → True Giant


Traits: Majin "Giant Tribe," engineered by Twilight Valentine from True Giant data — 2–2.5m at rest, grows several times larger in combat — build varies skinny to chubby, exotic hair colors (blue, green, etc). Sub-species: Cyclops, Hecatoncheires.


Abilities: Immense physical prowess and high Magic Resistance baseline. Greater Giant gains Intrinsic Skill Magic Nullification — total magic imperviousness. True Giant ("Divine Giant") — earthborn divine entity, power rivaling True Dragons, immortal Material Body immune to aging.


Notable Members: Dagruel

cardPool.title: High Elf
cardPool.value:
Name: High Elf
Rank: C | Existence Value: 5,000–15,000
Evolution Chain: High Elf → Sage → Saint → Divine Human

Traits: Graceful, pointed-eared — frequent black-market slavery targets due to beauty. Formerly united under Super-Magic Kingdom (Princess Kagali), destroyed overnight by Demon Lord Milim; survivors split three ways — Kagali's remnant founded Jistav, others seeded Sarion, remainder retreated into illusion-barriered forests.

Abilities: Strong nature/elemental magic affinity — eternal youth, maturation halts at 20, near-lifelong youthful appearance (500–800yr average lifespan) — no notable sensory enhancement documented.

Notable Members: Kagali

cardPool.title: Merchant
cardPool.value:
Players who choose Merchant as their class start as young fledgling entrepreneurs or business owners in the location they select. They often interact with a variety of powerful, well known characters, building relationships for business. They may also even get involved in the criminal underworld, even on accident. 

Merchants are astute businesspeople adept at navigating commerce and trade. With keen negotiation skills, they identify lucrative deals and investment opportunities to maximize wealth. Powerful Merchants even establish trade routes and networks of contacts, shaping economies and political landscapes.

Privately, most merchants are also active in the black market, partaking in illegal trades and activity. Many are willing to lie, cheat and steal what ever they need to get ahead.

cardPool.title: Mai Furuki
cardPool.value:
Mai Furuki, an Otherworlder, joined forces with Yuuki to topple Emperor Rudra Nam Ul Nasca. Executed by the Imperial Guardians, she was resurrected as a Deathman by Kagali in the Star Palace. 

Absorbing the power of a Seraph, she transformed into a Mystic Angel, forced to join Michael’s army.

Mai appears as a typical Japanese high school student, with black hair and brown eyes. Upon becoming a Mystic Angel, she gained three sets of white wings.

Serious and taciturn, Mai dutifully follows orders. Grateful for Yuuki’s aid in her transition to Tensura, she’s committed to returning to her sickly brother in Japan.

Summoned to another world, she found support  from Yuuki’s otherworlder program within the Free Guild.  Becoming part of his plot to overthrow the Eastern Empire’s tyrant ruler.

Ultimate Skill: Terra Mater. granting control over space. 

Sub-Skill: Survivable Space Automatic Adjustment, Traveler

 Arts: Instant Motion 
Time Warp
 Equipment: Crescent Bow

cardPool.title: Swordsmen
cardPool.value:
Class: Swordsman 
Role: A skilled warrior proficient in the art of swordsmanship. They possess exceptional speed, precision, and technique, wielding their blades with grace and deadly efficiency.
cardPool.description: A swordmaster in Tensura is a skilled warrior proficient in the art of swordsmanship. They possess exceptional speed, precision, and technique, wielding their blades with grace and deadly efficiency despite relying less on magicules. Clad in sturdy armor and armed with their trusty sword, they are formidable adversaries on the battlefield, capable of dispatching enemies with swift and precise strikes. With years of training and experience, they command respect and admiration, embodying the warrior spirit of honor, courage, and determination.

cardPool.title: Lizardman
cardPool.value:
Name: Lizardman
Rank: C~B | Existence Value: 3,000–7,000
Evolution Chain: Lizardman → Dragonewt → True Dragonewt → Divine Dragon

Traits: Degraded Demi-Human descendants of Dragonewts (Dragon/Human progeny) — dwell in marshes around Lake Siss, use natural labyrinth terrain defensively — scaly skin, webbed feet, some grow hair — subsist on lake fish, use magically lit dwellings.

Abilities: Exceptional maneuverability in swamp/marsh terrain — coordinated groups rival military strength of a small human nation. No innate magic affinity.

Notable Members: Gabiru

cardPool.title: Feldway
cardPool.value:
Feldway possesses dark blue eyes, blonde hair, and an androgynous yet strikingly beautiful appearance. They often wear a red military uniform, which transforms into black armor and white robes during battle. With three sets of white feathered wings, Feldway exudes an aura of power and intensity.

Initially a dutiful servant to Veldanava, Feldway’s demeanor shifted over time. They became bitter and resentful, blaming humanity for their perceived abandonment by their creator. Despite their intense rage, Feldway maintains a sense of pride in their material body and forms a bond with the sealed titan Fenn.

Created as the first of the Seven Angels of Origin by Veldanava, Feldway was tasked with guarding humanity and eliminating threats. However, their bitterness grew as they perceived Veldanava’s absence and became determined to destroy creation itself as revenge for what they believe is Veldanava’s abandonment.
They align themselves with the Phantom race and Zelanus with the Insectar.

Zelanus has a silver exoskeleton made of Hihi’irokane, with two sets of red wings and three pairs of arms. He can sprout mouths on any part of his body and has antennae on his forehead.

Zelanus is confident but cautious, analyzing threats before engaging. He prioritizes his safety and is willing to sacrifice even his own children for victory.

Born from Ivarage’s magicules, Zelanus was mentored by Veldanava. He subjugated his cryptid siblings, becoming the king of the Insectoids.

 Zelanus allied with Feldway and aimed to claim half of the world as his own. He dismissed cooperation unless absolutely necessary and allied with Michael to bolster his power.

Skills:

	•	Ultimate Skill: Sephirot, Lord of Life, with Life Domination.
	•	Extra: Ultra Sense.
	•	Arts: Devastator Virus, which manipulates microscopic Dark Cells to devour and absorb targets, and Restore Life, which remakes beings into stronger forms using soul energy.

cardPool.title: The Moderate Harlequin Alliance
cardPool.value:
The Moderate Harlequin Alliance, led by Kagali with Laplace as Vice President, is a group of powerful majin created by Kagali herself. Comprised of Clayman, Footman, and Tear, they are a versatile team capable of undertaking various tasks for a price. Their primary rule is never to betray their friends and clients.

Originating the former Super-Magic Kingdom of the Elves, the group’s members have intricate backgrounds. Tear, Footman, and Clayman were created by Kagali, with Clayman being engineered as her most trusted subordinate and a potential True Demon Lord. Tear and Footman possess formidable combat prowess, while Laplace, the strongest member, leads the group.

The weakest member of the alliance ranks at least at a Demon Lord Seed’s level. Laplace stands out as the most powerful, while Clayman excels in intelligence and strategy despite lacking raw physical power. Working closely with Yuuki, they are all very loyal. 

Player will be newest member. Automatically Rank: Special S.

cardPool.title: Majin
cardPool.value:
Majinization, also known as Monsterization, is the transformation of a non-magicule-based lifeform into a Majin or Monster. It happens when a being is exposed to an excessive amount of magicules, undergoes magic rituals, or encounters unique circumstances. While an overdose of magicules would typically lead to death, some individuals adapt and are reborn as monsters.

Greater Majin:

	•	General term for Majin Over A Rank.
	•	Hold unimaginable power, often serving Demon Lords as elite troops.
	•	Examples: Gelmud (before naming spree), Geld (Orc Lord state).

Sub-Demon Lord Level:

	•	Majin surpassing Greater Majin, reaching Special-A Rank.
	•	Powerful pawns for Demon Lords, capable of taking down nations with preparation.
	•	Examples: Orc Disaster Geld, Three Beastketeers (prior to Carrion’s Harvest Festival).

Demon Lord Level:

	•	Majin with strength comparable to Demon Lords but not officially recognized as such.
	•	Control large areas of land, often with Sub-Demon Lord subordinates.

cardPool.title: The World Voice
cardPool.value:
An announcement system that speaks to the players subconscious. It announces and clarifies important events in the story such as Evolution, obtaining new skills, and increasing EP. 

It also creatively narrates fights by announcing when a character utilizes a skill.

The World Voice is something only the player can hear. At the beginning of the scenario, it tells the player their chosen race, class, and Racial Starting Existence Value. 

It also announces results of Evolution to ensure the evolution followed the proper evolution chain. It will announce a message into the players subconscious similar to the following

“Evolution complete! You have evolved from Insect to Insectar! Your EV has increased significantly to ___” 

Fill in the ___ with the players estimated EV after evolution. 

This message will always follow the Evolution Chain provided in the race description.

Manas, a species of Information Body, possess the unique ability to freely manipulate infons and exist purely in information form. They typically appear human-like, reflecting the self-image of their original hosts. They typically reside in their hosts subconscious and do not have a body of their own. 

 Mnown Manas are Chronoa, who has her own body, as well as Michael and Ciel who coexist within the subconscious of their respective hosts.

Infons, the smallest particles containing information, are present in all matter, including souls and skills. Their near-zero mass and resistance to space and time allow for information transfer without time delay. However, observing them is challenging, typically requiring specific conditions such as inside Rimuru’s stomach or an Infinity Prison. Manipulating infons is limited to Digital Natures, essential for movement in the Stopped World.

cardPool.title: The Frost Palace
cardPool.value:
The Frost Palace - Realm of Demon Lord Guy Crimson

The Frost Palace stands as a magnificent castle, its beauty contrasting with the icy landscape of the Ice Continent. Ruled by Demon Lord Guy Crimson with support of Velzard, it exudes an aura of power and elegance, befitting its ruler.

After his defeat by Veldanava, Guy Crimson chose to make the frozen ruins of the Imperial Capital his new home, seeing it as fate’s design.

Originally the Imperial Capital of the Super-Magic Empire in the era of the High Humans, it was here that Guy Crimson was summoned into the Central World by the Sorcerer Emperor Jahil.

A battle between Guy and Velzard resulted in the freezing of the capital and a shift in the planet’s axis, transforming the continent into the north pole. Entranced by the beauty of the frozen palace, Guy opted to maintain its icy facade, with Velzard’s aura ensuring its preservation.

cardPool.value:
Goblina
Parallel: Hobgoblin
Evolution Precious: Goblin (Female)
Evolution Next: Death Oni

Appearance:
Goblina, the evolved form of female Goblins, maintains the signature green skin of their predecessors but with improved stature. On average, they stand at a height of 160 centimeters. They are far more attractive, often resembling beautiful human women rather than goblins.

Abilities:
With their evolution, Goblina swiftly develops enhanced intellect and memory capabilities. Their physical constitution and strength undergo significant improvement as well.

Goblina’s ranks vary based on factors such as equipment, armor, individual class and skills, and overall strength. Notably, the four Goblins designated as Goblin Lords by Rimuru exhibit greater prowess than their counterparts. Rigurd, crowned as Goblin King, has achieved an impressive A rank in strength.

cardPool.title: Extra Skill Info
cardPool.value: Extra Skills are more powerful and versatile than Common Skills, obtained through effort. They vary widely in power and can potentially match or exceed Unique Skills. They can also be Intrinsic Skills or Sub-Skills of Unique and Ultimate Skills.

cardPool.title: Unique Skill Info
cardPool.value: Unique Skills are expressions of the user’s mind, emotions, and desires. They offer completely unique powers, often born after overcoming trials or experiencing growth. While they vary greatly in abilities, they provide a high level of resistance to lower-level skills, including other Unique Skills. They evolve with the user and can eventually crystallize into Ultimate Skills with strong emotions and energy.

cardPool.title: Michael
cardPool.value:
Michael, a manas originally a will within the Ultimate Skill Michael, served as an antagonist until his demise in battle against Rimuru Tempest. As a manas, he exists within the subconscious of his host supporting or manipulating, most prominently Emperor Rudra Nam Ul Nasca. 

In appearance, Michael shares Rudra Nam Ul Nasca’s body, except for red eyes in illustrations, wearing a white outfit with red accents.

His personality is marked by extreme self-righteousness, believing in absolute justice and relying on logical reasoning.

Originally a hollow ego, Michael allied with Feldway to revive his master, Veldanava. Gaining control of Rudra’s body, he formed truces with various factions and eventually faced Rimuru’s forces.

Michael wielded Ultimate Skills like Michael, Lord of Justice, and possessed abilities such as Battlewill and Holy Magic. He also exhibited the Digital Nature trait, allowing him to manipulate infons freely.

cardPool.title: The Star Palace
cardPool.value: The Star Palace, also known as Heaven, is the Place of Beginning where Veldanava first awoke during the dawn of creation. It exists in a world isolated from all other universes yet adjacent to them simultaneously. Access is granted through a special Key for inter-dimensional travel or via the Heaven Tower, guarded by Dagruel. The Heaven Tower, one of the two remaining Holy Relics created by Veldanava, safeguards Tensura from destruction and serves as the entry point into the Star Palace. Currently, it serves as the base of operations for Heaven’s Army, the combined forces of Feldway and Zelanus bent on conquering Tensura.

cardPool.title: Monster Info
cardPool.value:
Types of Monsters in Tensura include:

	•	Magic Beasts: Monsters closely related to or evolved from animals. Mystic Beasts are a sub-category of Magic Beasts that primarily consume magicules for nutrition.
	•	Majin: Monsters possessing proper intelligence and rational thought similar to humans and demi-humans. They can be born as majin, evolve into one, or result from the monsterization of intelligent lifeforms.
	•	Named Monsters: Monsters who are named and generally evolve into a higher race. They find it easier to acquire skills.
	•	Unique Monsters: Individuals of a particular monster race born with unique characteristics, traits, or abilities not typical of their species. They are usually stronger and smarter than ordinary monsters. Examples include Orc Lords and Rimuru Tempest.

Demi-Human races like Goblins, Orcs, and Lizardmen, though often called “Monsters,” are categorized as the Demonic Tribe, referring to intelligent enemies of humanity, regardless of their magical nature.

cardPool.title: Free Guild Rules
cardPool.value:
Adventurer Examinations:

To rise in ranks as an adventurer, one must undergo specialized exams conducted by seasoned proctors. Accumulating Points is essential, and failure means waiting before attempting again.

Rank Up System:
Adventurers need a certain amount of Points to qualify for exams. Passing grants access to the next rank. Failure requires waiting and regaining Points.

Exams:

	1.	Duel: Duel the teacher at anytime to advance. If you fail, you go down a rank.
	2.	Exploration: Navigate a simulated ruin to test skills.
	3.	Subjugation: Face a summoned monster of the test’s rank.

Known Tests:

	•	E Rank: Hound Dog
	•	D Rank: Dark Goblin
	•	C Rank: Lesser Bat
	•	B Rank: Lesser Dragon

Ranks:
From F (default) to A-Plus (Hero-class). A-Minus is an honorary rank. A rank signifies the pinnacle of strength.

Quests:
Essential income sources for adventurers, posted on Guild bulletin boards. Gathering rare materials also earns Points, vital for rank advancement.

cardPool.title: Elementals
cardPool.value:
Elementals are spiritual lifeforms embodying specific elements, formed from natural energy or higher elementals and often lend their power to people they like if they ask for it. 

Lesser Elementals offer minimal power and lack personalities. 

Medium Elementals have personalities and can engage in battle. 

Greater Elementals are humanoid and possess immense power at Special A rank. They’re selective about lending power.

Elemental Lords are legendary beings comparable to Demon Lords, rarely offering their power except through Spirit Magic contracts. They can incarnate into fairies. 

The Great Holy Spirits, led by the Elemental Queen, wield all eight elements and rule over all elementals. 

Fairies are incarnated elementals, Daemons and Angels stem from darkness and light elementals. 

Chosen Heroes have a symbiotic bond with light or dark elementals. 

Lesser elements: space, earth, water, wind, and fire etc.

 Greater elements: light, darkness, time. Some exhibit multiple elements.

cardPool.title: The City of the Forgotten Dragon
keys: The City of the Forgotten Dragon
cardPool.value: The City of the Forgotten Dragon, ruled by Demon Lord Milim, is home to descendants of dragons, totaling fewer than a hundred thousand. Governed by the Dragon Faithful, all citizens are dragonewts with formidable combat prowess, ranked C and above. Instead of a standing army, priest warriors defend the realm. The Central Temple serves as the core of governance, overseeing equitable distribution of goods collected from all citizens. This system mirrors the concept of “universal basic income,” ensuring all receive a minimum share, with additional rewards for hard work. Middray holds authority to determine contributions to society, granted by Milim, yet subject to dismissal by other priests to prevent tyranny. This checks-and-balances system fosters effective leadership and organization among the city’s inhabitants.

cardPool.title: Beast Kingdom Eurazania
cardPool.value:
Inhabited by Lycanthrope, Eurazania is a powerful nation ruled by a council of elders. Known for its fierce warriors and strong sense of honor, it maintains friendly ties with the Jura Tempest Federation.

Eurazania stands as one of the continent’s superpowers, boasting a formidable army that rivals Englassia or Lubelius. The capital’s population harbors a significant number of skilled warriors, with Lycanthropes already wielding formidable power, ranked as A-minus when fully unleashed. The kingdom bolsters its military prowess by taming powerful magic beasts, notably Thunder Tigers. The apex of its military might lies in the Beast Master’s Brigade, led by the Three Beastketeers. Comprising highly trained combatants, even the weakest among them holds an A-rank ranking. With unwavering loyalty to Carrion, they dedicate their lives to protecting Eurazania from all threats, including monsters and wild beasts.

cardPool.title: Adventurer Guilds
cardPool.value:

They can also be sent on various missions all over the world. This can be to guard a village, escort an important figure, explore a dangerous cave system and much more. This is the most varied and unpredictable job in the world.

cardPool.title: Englassia Kingdom
cardPool.value: The Kingdom of Englassia is the most advanced human city in the world. Strategically located west of the Jura Forest, it serves as a central hub for transportation, commerce, and diplomacy. Its royal capital is renowned for its meticulously planned layout, with imposing structures dominating the skyline. The centerpiece is a majestic castle situated on a tranquil lake, connected to the city by four grand bridges. Englassia’s advanced culture is evident in its bustling squares, vibrant theaters, and grand concert halls. The city is divided into four distinct districts, each catering to different aspects of life, from commerce to residential living. Security is paramount, with knights stationed at key points to maintain public order. Englassia’s economy thrives on its wine industry, renowned for its quality and diversity. While beer production exists, it struggles to match the excellence of the kingdom’s wines, leaving much to be desired for enthusiasts.

	•	B Rank: EP between 8,000 and 9,000 - Can damage an entire town.

	•	A- Rank: EP between 10,000 and 100,000 - Equivalent to Hazard-class, posing a threat to larger regions.

cardPool.title: Floor 95
cardPool.value:

Research Facility: A joint research facility for Elves, Dwarves, Humans and Vampires.
There's a door that leads to the 95th floor besides the stairs on each floor, with the entry fee being three silver coins. Those visiting through the door could only access the inn and equipment shop.

cardPool.title: Charybdis
cardPool.value:
Charybdis is a gigantic one-eyed mindless blood-thirsty calamity-class Monster, heralded as the Ruler of the Skies. Born from a cloud of Veldora's Magicules, it can be said to be part of Veldora's "family", similar to Rimuru as it is also said to be Veldora's child. As it has no solid sense of self, it operates solely to satisfy its lust for destruction.

Charybdis had the appearance of a massive shark-like dragon around 50 meters in length with a singular ominous eye. She had thick dragon scales covering her entire body in addition to wings and horns, with a prominent tail and dorsal fin giving her a fish-like atmosphere. 

Charybdis is sometimes summoned by power hungry individuals who seek to use her to destroy their enemies. 

Upon defeating her, Charybdis drops her core. Absorbing Charybdis Core grants the user a significant EV bonus as well as Charybdis signature skills:

Gravity Manipulation
Magic Jamming
Ultraspeed Regeneration

cardPool.title: Elemental Magic
cardPool.value:
Elemental Magic:

manipulates natural forces through spells and gathering Magicules. It encompasses various skills like Fireball, Ice Lance, and Wind Cutter. 

Sub Types:
Barrier Magic erects barriers for protection or containment. Compound Magic combines elemental magics for amplified effects, like Explosive Flame Magic. Contract Magic enforces contracts between parties. Creation Magic shapes substances, often used to create golems. Earth Magic manipulates the earth, from creating walls to trapping opponents. Enhancement Magic buffs targets’ stats or equipment. Fire Magic generates heat and flames. Flight Magic enables flight. Gravity Magic alters gravity’s effects. Ice Magic saps heat, with spells like Ice Blizzard. Mental Magic affects minds. Nuclear Magic relies on Abyss Cores for powerful effects like Nuclear Cannon. Optical Magic distorts images. Restoration Magic heals injuries or toxins. Spatial Magic manipulates space for storage or transport. Wind Magic controls wind.

cardPool.title: Holy Magic
cardPool.value: Holy Magic is a Spirit Magic type requiring a pact with a Holy Spirit or God. Users tap into The Power of Faith, channeling beliefs into power. Basic-Level Holy Magic purifies, heals, and harms undead. Healing, Holy Bell, and Prison Field are common skills. Miracle-Level Holy Magic, or God’s Miracle, manipulates Spiritrons for potent offensive spells. Disintegration and High Heal exemplify its power. Regeneration and Resurrection can heal severe injuries or bring back the dead. Holy Magic relies on faith, with stronger belief yielding greater magic potency.

cardPool.title: Existence Value/EP
cardPool.value:
Existence Value, also known as Energy, is the energy (Magicules, Holy Power etc) contained within the body and soul of an individual or object. All characters,magic items and weapons have an Existence Value.

 Existence Points are an objective and numerical measurement of Existence Value called Existence Point shortened to EP — was created by Tempest utilizing the precise analytical powers of Ramiris's Small World, acting as the basis for their Rank system.



Generate EV/EP value based off of their story card or race for NPC’s. For players, use their last known EP, or the average EP / EV for their race.

Players can check their EP easily by concentrating and estimating.

(EV = EP)
cardPool.description:
Existence Value, also known as Energy or "Existential Force", is the energy (Magicules, Holy Power, Magic Power, Aura, etc.) contained within the body and soul of an individual or object. 

 Existence Points are an objective and numerical measurement of Existence Value called Existence Point shortened to EP — was created by Tempest utilizing the precise analytical powers of Ramiris's Small World, acting as the basis for their internal Rank system. It's an improved and more precise version of the rudimentary measurements utilized by the Eastern Empire. 

All characters, and magic items and weapons have an Existence Value. In individuals, EV can be increased by increasing power such as physical, magical or even equipment levels. 

EV/EP also dictate the ranks and classes of danger an individual is assigned.

cardPool.title: Summoning Magic
cardPool.value: Summoning Magic involves summoning beings from alternate realms, primarily Daemons. It requires mastery of spatial magic, a significant amount of Magicules, and a contractual agreement with the summoned entity. Summoning Daemons involves providing sacrifices, either Magicules or living beings, based on their strength. Failure to meet their demands can have dire consequences. Summoning Elementals is simpler, as they operate based on instinct or directive. Sentient Elementals are rare and less inclined to serve. Summoning Otherworlders is the most demanding, requiring substantial resources and time. Contracts are inscribed onto their souls using Mental Magic, posing fatal risks to unprepared summoners due to Magicule drain.

cardPool.title: Spirit Magic
cardPool.value:
Spirit Magic:

harnesses the power of elementals, allowing users to manipulate natural energies. Unlike regular magic, it operates within the laws of physics, functioning even in Anti-Magic Areas or Holy Fields. 

Users form contracts with elementals, requiring no chants for spellcasting. They can summon contracted elementals, ordering them to attack or fusing with their power. 

Types include Darkness, Earth, Flame, Light, Space, Time, Water, and Wind Spirit Magic, each tailored to its respective elemental affinity.  

Necromancy, a subset, manipulates Negative Grudges from Evil Spirits and Ghosts. It’s vulnerable to Holy Magic’s purifying effects. Spells like Birthday, Curse Bind, Immortal Legion Creation, Raise Dead, and Zombie Breath showcase its dark abilities. 

Miscellaneous spells include Divination for foresight and Elemental Communication for interaction with elementals.

In terms of personality, Dagruel surprises many with his quiet confidence and astute awareness of the deceit prevalent among his fellow Demon Lords. He possesses a deep respect for strength and engages in fierce battles with Veldora Tempest, while also maintaining territorial boundaries that often lead to confrontations with Luminous Valentine. Despite his epithet as the “Earthquake,” Dagruel harbors genuine concern for those close to him, exemplified by his compassionate actions towards Dino and his strategic approach to his sons’ training in Tempest.

cardPool.title: True Dragon Magic
cardPool.value: True Dragon Magic, inherent to True Dragons and their chosen, extends its influence through various elemental manifestations. Frost Magic, wielded by those with the Frost Dragon Factor, conjures chilling blizzards. Scorch Magic, from the Scorch Dragon Factor, unleashes searing lava and fiery breath. Star King Magic, gifted by the Star King Dragon Factor, commands powerful cosmic energies. Storm Magic, borne by the Storm Dragon Factor, summons black flames, lightning, and destructive winds. These magics, both feared and revered, reflect the immense power and elemental mastery of True Dragons and their blessed kin.

cardPool.title: Dark Magic
cardPool.value: Dark Magic, primarily used by Daemons, encompasses powerful spells like “Forbidden” and the advanced form known as Nihility Magic. Nihility Magic taps into the abyss of hell, summoning the “Void” and harnessing Minus Energy to annihilate existence. This magic poses a threat even to Ultimate Skill users due to its immense destructive potential. Spells like “Abyss Annihilation” and “Nihilistic Banish” exemplify its formidable nature. Plus Energy can counter Minus Energy, but its usage demands caution, as even a slight misstep can lead to catastrophic consequences.

cardPool.title: Ashura
cardPool.value:
Ashura 
Race: True Giant
EP: 119,000,000
was the Mad King of the Giants, split into Dagruel, Glassord, and Fenn by Veldanava.

Appearance:
Ashura takes the form of a humanoid giant with three sets of arms and three heads. Towering over others, Ashura’s imposing presence commands attention, embodying the essence of raw power.

Personality:
A mix of the three brothers. 

Background:
A long time ago, in the age of myth, an evil giant emerged from the depths of the earth, wreaking havoc wherever it went. Eventually, Veldanava intervened and managed to defeat the giant, splitting it into three separate entities: Dagruel, Glassord, and Fenn. Over time, Dagruel and Glassord renounced their malevolent ambitions and strived for redemption, while Fenn clung to his wicked ways and was subsequently sealed away. As a reward for his change of heart, Veldanava granted Dagruel a parcel of land and entrusted him with the duty of guarding the Heaven Tower to prevent Fenn’s release.

In the age of myth, the earth birthed an evil giant whose rampage was quelled by Veldanava. From its remnants emerged Glassord and his brothers, Dagruel and Fenn. While Fenn clung to their malevolent origins, Glassord and Dagruel embraced redemption, forsaking the ambitions of their dark past.

cardPool.title: Illusion Magic
cardPool.value: Illusion Magic, drawing from Mental and Spirit Magic, manipulates the Spiritual and Astral Bodies, or even the Soul, to create diverse effects. Ranging from sensory illusions to direct interference with spiritual entities, it encompasses various types of spells. Great Secret Arts like “Possession” transfer souls, offering longevity at the cost of skills. Mystery Arts like “Reincarnation” reset lifespans by rebirthing souls. Secret Arts include “Resurrection” and “Revival,” reviving the deceased or rejuvenating the living. Talisman Arts, such as “Astral Bind,” impose spiritual constraints. Miscellaneous spells like “Magic Sensor” detect Magicules, while “Flame Wall” conjures illusory barriers. Illusion Magic’s versatility extends to telepathy, sleep induction, and image projection, making it a potent force in magic.

cardPool.title: Engraving Magic
cardPool.value:
Engraving Magic

Engraving Magic is magic that allows the user to "enchant" people or objects with spells which allows them to use magic without possessing related knowledge or skills. It can also be used to design fully autonomous, self-sustaining magical devices, like the automatic barrier generator installed along the pathway connecting Tempest and the Kingdom of Blumund.

cardPool.title: Physics Magic
cardPool.value:
Physics Magic, innovated by Rimuru Tempest, delivers purely physical effects, circumventing anti-magic defenses as it operates independently of Magicules. One prominent spell is “Megiddo,” unleashing divine wrath with unstoppable force. Its variant, “Argos,” offers divine insight, granting unparalleled vision. With “Megiddo - Revised,” Rimuru enhances this formidable spell, further showcasing the limitless potential of Physics Magic.

This magic is extremely creative and requires greater standing of the laws of physics. It can be extremely deadly

cardPool.title: Soul Magic
cardPool.value: Soul Magic, wielded by Elemental Souls, taps into the fundamental laws governing their respective elements, operating within the realm of physics. Unlike conventional magic, it transcends anti-magic barriers like Holy Fields. Varieties include Darkness Soul Magic, channeling the power of darkness; Earth Soul Magic, harnessing the essence of earth; Flame Soul Magic, commanding fiery energies; Water Soul Magic, manipulating the flow of water; and Wind Soul Magic, mastering the force of wind.

cardPool.title: Stella
cardPool.value:
Stella, a Dragonewt and member of the Dragon Faithful, is deeply devoted to worshiping Milim Nava. 

Stella is a young girl characterized by her striking blue hair, which she ties into thin twintails, and her matching blue eyes. She typically adorns herself in blue attire, akin to the clothing worn by other members of the Dragon Faithful, a group devoted to the worship of the Demon Lord Milim. Additionally, she often wears a hairband as a part of her ensemble. 

She embodies loyalty and admiration for her Demon Lord. Despite her initial brashness, she shows humility and diligence in learning culinary skills. In battle, she values fairness and honor, remaining composed and compassionate even in challenging situations. Stella’s mission in Tempest is to deepen her connection with Milim, representing the faith with unwavering dedication.

cardPool.title: Ghost King Adalmann
cardPool.value:
Adalmann 
Race: Wight King
EP: 877,333
Guardian of the 70th floor of the Dungeon and is a member of Rimuru’s Twelve Guardian Lords. He appears as a lich-like being in clergy robes, displaying extreme reverence towards Luminous Faith and later towards “Rimuruism.” Despite his fanatical loyalty, he harbors insecurities about his abilities, particularly regarding his proficiency in Holy Magic after his resurrection as a Wight King.

Born a prince of a small nation under the rule of the Holy Empire Ruberios, Adalmann rose through the ranks of the Western Holy Church to become a cardinal and the greatest master of Holy Magic in his era. After his demise in battle against undead forces, He revived as a Wight due to the ambient miasma, he was bound to serve Demon Lord Kazalim until freed by Shuna.

He possesses Ultimate Gifts such as the Necronomicon, Book of Magic, and various Magic abilities including Multilayer Barrier, Elemental Magic, Holy Magic, and Spirit Magic. He’s the greatest mage.

cardPool.title: Gozurl and Mezurl
cardPool.value:
Both possess an EP: 	130,000 
Gozul 
is a large humanoid ox with thick horns and a nose ring, typically seen bare-chested wearing trousers and a loincloth. Initially introduced as hot-blooded and overconfident, his experience in the Tempest tournament and duties as a labyrinth guardian have led to reflection and a sincere desire to grow stronger. Gozul was made to submit and placed inside the labyrinth as a floor boss due to his resemblance to a minotaur.

Mezul, on the other hand, is a large humanoid horse with a dark mane, adorned in a one-shoulder shirt and chains around his neck. Like Gozul, Mezul initially exhibited hot-blooded and overconfident traits but has since mellowed out and aims to grow.

And unique gifts like Limiter, which creates a space to limit opponents, extra skills such as Magic Jamming and Self-Regeneration. And powerful arts like the Horse Ultra Spear and Lightning Horn, a piercing attack where their horns double in length and are enveloped in lightning.

cardPool.title: Evolution
cardPool.value:
Evolution occurs when certain specified races grow stronger or gain a significant amount of magicules. This can be via being named, becoming a demon lord, absorbing magicules, or sometimes training. They follow a specific path and once the final evolution is reached they can no longer evolve. 

Evolution often grants Unique or Ultimate skills, as well as evolving and upgrading old ones.

The creature also typically undergoes a slight physical change in appearance. Each evolution is significantly stronger than its previous form, granting greatly increased physical and magical abilities. 
This is an advancement of race, so EV should be recalculated based off the new racial starting existence value, 

Formula as follows: Current EV + Starting EV of new race. If none is provided, multiply EV by 5.

Evolved creatures follow their Evolution Chain linearly. For example, an Insect always evolves into an Insectar.
cardPool.description:
Evolution occurs when certain specified races grow stronger or gain a significant amount of magicules. This can be via being named, becoming a demon lord, absorbing magicules, or sometimes training. They follow a specific path and once the final evolution is reached they can no longer evolve. 

Evolution frequently grants new skills, as well as evolving and upgrading old ones making them more powerful and efficient. 

The creature also typically undergoes a slight physical change in appearance. Each evolution is significantly stronger than its previous form, granting greatly increased physical and magical abilities.

cardPool.title: Saint
cardPool.value:
Saint
+ 1,000,000 added to Existence Value.
Rank
Special S

The term “Saint” refers to individuals, regardless of race, who have undergone Awakening, evolving into Spiritual Lifeforms.

Awakening:

Becoming a Saint involves intense cultivation and pushing the mind and body to their limits, breaking through mental barriers in life and death situations.

Attributes:

	•	Terrifying Power: Saints wield immense energy and strength, potentially standing on even footing with True Demon Lords and True Chosen Heroes.
	•	Potential for Ultimate Skills: Saints possess souls strong enough to potentially host an Ultimate Skill.
	•	Incomplete Saints: These individuals have awakened but their flesh has not fully ascended, retaining human weaknesses.
	•	Complete Saints: They have matched mental awakening with their physical body, becoming almost entirely spiritual. They are freed from human limitations, although only the most powerful have the potential to achieve Divinity.

Dragonewts are a race of Beastfolk Demi-Humans descended from Dragons and Humans. They are either born naturally or evolve from Lizardmen that have restored their roots. Dragonewts are considered B-rank on average, with an average lifespan of about two hundred years.

Appearance:
A dragonewt’s appearance can vary depending on the user’s will. Some may not look much different than lizardmen, while others may have a more human-like appearance. They can sprout dragon wings, elongated horns, and are covered by dense scales.

Background:
Dragonewts come from Lizardmen that have evolved or descended from dragons that “humanized” themselves and mated with the human race.

	•	Dragon Scales
	•	Flame Breath
	•	Thunder Breath

However, without Divinity, they still possess a mortal, albeit extremely long, lifespan. Only the strongest among the True Dragonewts can reach Divinity and become Divine Dragons.

Abilities:

	•	Dragon Skin
	•	Flame Breath
	•	Thunder Breath

Evolves into Divine Dragon.

cardPool.value:
Name: Vampire
Rank: B~Special A | EV: 10,000–100,000
Evolution Chain: Vampire → Overcomer → True Vampire 


Traits: Immortal, blood-dependent beings of ethereal beauty — pale skin, sharp fangs, thrall-inducing eyes — renowned for manipulation and seduction alongside physical menace. True Vampires can absorb life forces without even touching the targets in an area.


Abilities: Superhuman strength, speed, agility — precision lethal strikes with unnatural grace. Some possess bat/mist transformation for stealth and enhanced mobility. Hypnotic/thrall-inducing charm capable of subjugating victims' will.


Notable Members: Luminous Valentine

cardPool.title: High Blood
cardPool.value:
High Blood
Rank: Special S
The final evolution of Vampires. 
High Blood, refers to the original race created by Veldanava to populate the earth. Humans, Demi-Humans, and Vampires can all trace their roots back to this Ancestor.

Properties

High Blood are beings of monstrous power. They have no need for physical nourishment and can recover their energy by absorbing the life-force of those around them, a trait inherited by Vampires. As divine beings, they possess an immortal Material Body that will never age.

Background

In Veldanava’s pursuit of diverse and sentient life, he intended to populate the world with a race of immortal spirits bearing flesh. To facilitate this process, Veldanava created a singular being, Twilight Valentine, and ordered them to reproduce. Despite challenges, Twilight eventually succeeded in creating High Blood, satisfying Veldanava’s desires.

cardPool.title: Overcomer
cardPool.value:
Overcomer
•	Rank: Special A ~ Special S
Overcomer, also known as Vampire Noble is a blanket term for Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.

Physical Traits

Overcomers retain their Vampire features but have evolved past the normal Vampires’ limitations. They are no longer restricted by the need to take the blood of a human being and can endure exposure to sunlight.

Abilities

	•	Intrinsic Skills:
	•	Blood Raise: Allows the Overcomer to revive by absorbing blood.
	•	Charm: Enables manipulation of others.
	•	Coercion: Instills fear and submission.
	•	Paralyze: Temporarily immobilizes opponents.
	•	Shadow Motion: Swift movement through shadows.
	•	Steel Strength: Enhanced physical abilities.
	•	Transform: Change appearance.
	•	Ultraspeed Regeneration: Rapid healing.

cardPool.value:

	•	Basic training and introduction to the Dungeon environment.
	•	Enemies are F-rank small fry, with no instant death traps.
	•	Treasure rooms contain common goods guarded by D-ranked monsters.
	•	First boss encounter: B-rank Black Spider.

11-20: Advancing Challenges

	•	Enemies become slightly tougher, introducing D-rank monsters.
	•	Treasure rooms offer better equipment and marketable goods.
	•	Second boss encounter: B+ Evil Centipede.

21-30: Elite Encounters

	•	Greater challenge with B-plus Ogre Lord and subordinates.
	•	Higher rewards: 10 gold coins for successful parties.
	•	Introduction of “slotted” weapons as rare loot.
	•	Boss encounter: B+ Ogre and his five subordinates.

31-40: Escalating Peril

	•	Traps become deadlier, increasing risk of instant death.
	•	Focus on strategic navigation and caution. A boss floor against the A- ranked Tempest Serpent.

41-49: Deadly Obstacles

	Extreme danger with corrosive slimes and lethal traps

cardPool.title: Mage
cardPool.value:
Cast spells, bend reality, and study magic. Limited by creativity, magicuels knowledge.

Abilities:

	1.	Spellcasting: Cast offensive, defensive, and utility spells.
	2.	Elemental Manipulation: Control fire, water, earth, and air.
	3.	Mana Manipulation: Manage mana for spells and enhance abilities.
	4.	Ritual Magic: Perform complex rituals for powerful effects.
	5.	Spellbook Mastery: Carry spellbooks for spell memorization.
       6. Dark magic: Study dark powerful forbidden magic. 
Extra:

	•	Rank Advancement: Master spells and undertake quests for advancement.
	•	Spell Research: Develop new spells and enhance existing ones.
	•	Create and master custom spells

	1.	Elemental Magic
	2.	Summoning Magic
	3.	Barrier Magic
	4.	Healing Magic
	5.	Enchantment Magic
	6.	Transformation Magic
	7.	Illusion Magic
	8.	Time-Space Magic
	9.	Curse Magic
	10.	Spirit Magic

And more.
cardPool.description: In Tensura, magic is only limited by your power and understanding so mages have limitless potential. Delving into arcane arts, mastering spells, and bending elements to their will. They wield formidable power through intricate magical incantations and extensive knowledge of the mystic arts. Talented mages can even create custom, powerful spells with any effect they choose, even borrowing inspiration from other universes.

cardPool.title: Royalty
cardPool.value:
In the glittering halls of kingdoms, the Royalty class embarks on a perilous dance amidst the shadows of war and the thunder of revolution.

	1.	: Amidst opulent feasts and grandeur, nobles maneuver like pieces on a chessboard, each move a calculated bid for supremacy. Behind every smile lies a dagger, and every alliance hides a betrayal.
	2.	: Beyond the palace walls, the specter of conflict looms large. Royals must balance diplomatic finesse with martial prowess, lest their kingdoms crumble beneath the weight of warfare.
	3.	: Whispers of rebellion echo through the kingdom as disenfranchised masses rise against aristocratic rule. Royals must quell dissent or risk being swept away by the tides of revolution.
	4.	: Trusted confidants may conceal treacherous intentions, and loyal subjects may harbor ambitions of their own. In the court of kings, no one is above suspicion.
	5.	: Inheritance disputes and succession wars cast a long shadow over royal lineage. Siblings vie for the throne.
cardPool.description: Royalty inherit positions of power through noble lineage, wielding authority and influence over their realms. They uphold traditions and values, ensuring the welfare and prosperity of their subjects. Royalty face challenges such as political intrigue and external threats, requiring them to make difficult decisions for the greater good.

Appearance: Leon has long platinum gold hair, blue narrow eyes, and almost transparent skin. Despite his youthful appearance, he is three hundred years old.

Personality: While perceived as cold, Leon is kind-hearted, especially towards his childhood friend, Chloe Aubert. He becomes protective and hotheaded when Chloe is involved.

Proclaiming himself a Demon Lord, he engaged in a life-or-death battle with Kagali, taking her place on the Demon Lord council. Leon’s attempts to reunite with Chloe led to complications, ultimately leading him to relocate to El Dorado.

Cerberus is a large organization operating within the Eastern Empire, serving as the counterpart to the Freedom Association. They undertake a wide range of jobs, both legal and illegal, as long as it benefits the organization. They control the majority of the criminal under world.

cardPool.title: Clayman
cardPool.value:
Clayman
EV: 788,842
also known as the Marionette Master, was a cunning and manipulative Demon Lord from the era of the Ten Great Demon Lords. He met his demise at the hands of Rimuru Tempest after plotting against the Jura Tempest Federation and Rimuru, under Yuuki Kagurazaka’s direction.

In appearance, Clayman resembled a wealthy noble, with pale lavender hair and red eyes. He often wore elegant white attire. However, in combat form, he appeared darker and more menacing, with additional prosthetic arms and armor.

Clayman was known for his cunning and manipulative nature, preferring to operate from the shadows and manipulate others to achieve his goals. Despite his arrogance and overconfidence, he displayed loyalty to his superiors and comrades.

Created by Kagali as a Deathman, Clayman ascended to become one of the Ten Great Demon Lords. He harbored ambitions of increasing his influence and power, often resorting to manipulation and coercion to achieve his goals.

cardPool.title: Yuuki Kagurazaka
cardPool.value:
Yuuki Kagurazaka, 
EV: 1,900,000
Race: Human Saint

He has black hair and dark brown eyes. He looks as young as a middle schooler despite his real age being in the twenties.

a compassionate and determined individual, with a naive yet noble goal of achieving world peace. He hates anything that restricts freedom and vows to change the unfair world that caused him and others suffering.

Summoned into Tensura, Yuuki’s encounter with Kagali, a former demon lord, leads to the awakening of his Unique Skill Creator. This power enables him to resist curses and manipulations.

Encountering Mariabell Rossow, who obstructs his plans for a fair society, Yuuki’s resolve remains unwavering. He crushes the dark organization Echidna, reforming it into Cerberus.

cardPool.title: Laplace
cardPool.value:
Laplace
EP: 1,000,000
is a powerful Majin. He wears an eerie-looking mask with an asymmetrical smile adorned with rabbit ears and a jewel in the middle, giving off a sneering appearance. Beneath the mask, his red hair is visible, and he dons colorful and clown-like attire, including a robe tied with a bright ribbon, fur accents, gloves, and pointy boots.

Despite his laid-back demeanor, Laplace is a cunning individual who deeply cares for his friends and family. He often mocks his master, Kagali, but holds a strong bond with her and acts as a mentor to Clayman. Laplace avoids direct combat whenever possible, preferring sneaky and stealthy tactics to accomplish his goals. He harbors deep love for his family and is protective of them, becoming enraged only when they are mocked or bullied. In his previous life, Laplace was Sarion Grimwald, a Chosen Hero who attempted to slay the Chaos Dragon but was transformed into a Deathman by Kagali, losing his memories in the process.

cardPool.title: Footman
cardPool.value:
Footman
EV: 1,300,000
Brawler type. 
member of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance and a majin with a burly physique. His appearance includes wearing the outfit of a harlequin and a mask that covers his entire face, featuring a large nose and a mouth that switches between expressions of anger and happiness.

Despite his intimidating appearance, Footman possesses a composed and calculating personality. He speaks with extreme politeness and carefully chooses his words, particularly during combat where he uses taunts and mockery to manipulate his opponents. However, he also harbors deep care and loyalty towards his friends, often displaying intense emotions and occasional fits of rage when they are involved.

Originally an elf serving in the Super-Sorcery Kingdom, Footman remained loyal to Princess Kagali even after she transformed into the Deathman Kazalim. Alongside Tear and Clayman, he was resurrected by Kagali following the destruction of their castle by Milim Nava.

cardPool.title: Insectar
cardPool.value:
Evolution Chain: Insect, Insectar, Divine Insect. 
EV: 400,000 ~ 800,000. Insectar gain strength quickly. 

Overview:
also known as “Insect-Type Majin,” are a formidable race of Demi-Spiritual Majin originating from another universe. Evolved from ordinary insects, they possess immense power equivalent to that of a Demon Lord and are born for combat.

Insectars are born for combat, possessing immense physical strength, magic resistance, and the ability to manipulate elements. Some rare individuals, known as “Queen Types,” have the ability to create new insects en masse. Their strong Magic Resistance and ability to harness the power of Elementals makes them the natural counter against Daemons.

Appearance:
Insectars possess a vaguely humanoid appearance, standing upright on their legs. Their physical appearance varies greatly depending on the type of insect they evolved from, which can be one or even multiple different types of insects. They are often clad in metallic exoskeletons.

cardPool.title: Divinity
cardPool.value:
Divinity
+2,000,000 Existence Value upon reaching.
also known as “Divine Nature,” is attained by Spiritual Lifeforms with Material Bodies upon completing the Awakening process, granting them immortality. Unlike the conceptual God, those with Divinity are not omnipotent but are exceptionally potent beings known as Transcendents.

Transcendents possess the unique ability to freely transition between physical and spiritual forms, and they are liberated from the constraints of lifespan. With an intact Heart Core and sufficient energy, they can endlessly regenerate, even from the destruction of their Body or Soul.

However, most beings with Divinity are unable to reproduce, as their material bodies are typically transformed into pure energy, lacking functional genetics. They also wield a special energy known as Divine Ki, which, when utilized with their body or equipment, can enhance their attack and defense to the level of God Grade Equipment.

cardPool.title: Skills Info
cardPool.value:
Skills are extraordinary abilities that individuals can acquire through growth, mastering a power, fighting a difficult battle, evolving other skills etc. Acquisition involves an announcement by The World Voice. 

There are different types of skills and basic descriptions of their rarity and power:

	1.	Intrinsic Skill: Inherent abilities tied to the user’s physiology
	2.	Common Skill: Easy to master. Obtained often.
	3.	Extra Skill: Stronger than common. Obtained with more effort.
	4.	Unique Skill: Rare and powerful.
	5.	Ultimate Skill: The highest level of skills, very rare.
cardPool.description: Common Skills are basic with limited effects, easy to master but lack versatility. Extra Skills are more powerful and versatile, obtained through effort. Unique Skills are born from strong emotions, unique to the user and evolve with them. Ultimate Skills rewrite the world's laws, granting immunity to lesser abilities. Resist Skills enable users to withstand or nullify certain phenomena. Medical Skills replicate skill effects through biotechnology, like The Beast.

Clad in the attire of a master craftsman, Kurobe’s weathered hands tell the tale of countless hours spent at the forge, honing his skills to perfection. His eyes gleam with the passion of a true artisan, reflecting the fiery spirit that fuels his craftsmanship. Evolving into a Kijin only served to enhance his aura, imbuing him with a newfound sense of purpose and determination. Armed with his unnamed blacksmithing hammers, Kurobe’s presence in the forge is a testament to his unwavering dedication and unparalleled talent. In the world of Tensura, his craftsmanship shines as brightly as the flames of his forge.

cardPool.title: Potion
cardPool.value:
Potions:

Potions, derived from Hipokute Herbs, which can be found in places with high Magicule concentrations. They instantly heal injuries and are vital to most adventures.

Types:

	1.	Low Potion: Least potent, heals minor to moderate injuries, produced by diluting High Potions.
	2.	High Potion: Mid-tier potency, heals major injuries except lost limbs, made by diluting Full Potions or extracting 98% essence from herbs.
	3.	Full Potion: Most potent, heals fatal injuries, restores lost limbs regardless of time, created by achieving 99% essence extraction.

Usage & Limitations:

	•	Potions can be ingested or applied directly to wounds, instantly healing without scars.
	•	Full Potions reconstruct lost limbs using magicules, but cannot heal individuals resistant to magicules.
	•	They promote rapid cell growth, potentially harmful for those with malignant tumors.
	•	Potions restore tissue damage but don’t cure diseases or fully replenish magicule capacities in high-level magical beings.

cardPool.title: Damrada
cardPool.value:
Damrada of Gold, a former prime minister of the Nasca Kingdom, was known for his cold and calculating nature. As one of the governing officials of Cerberus, he pursued profit by any means necessary, even resorting to fraud and betrayal. His blond hair and goatee, reflected his title, often clad in expensive clothes adorned with gold embroideries. Originally an honest and light-hearted individual, his friendship with Granbell soured over time due to their switch in affiliations.

Damrada’s path intertwined with Emperor Rudra’s, leading him to seek a suitable candidate to kill the emperor to prevent a dire prophecy. He found Yuuki Kagurazaka, a charismatic young man with ambitions of world domination, and became his devoted follower. Together, they built up Cerberus, an underground organization, expanding its influence in the east.

Under the guise of an eastern merchant, Damrada manipulated Hinata Sakaguchi, captain of the Crusaders, by feeding her false information about Rimuru.

cardPool.title: Velzard
cardPool.value:
Velzard
EV: 80,000,000+
Race: True Dragon

Maintains the Frost Palace’s icy condition. With Blue Diamond eyes and Pearl-White hair, she resembles Milim Nava, wearing a white and blue dress, boots, and gold headband.

In battle Velzard’s appearance matures, with gold eyes and a curvy figure. Wearing a black and white dress with blue gloves and white heels.

As a dragon, Velzard boasts snow-white scales, black spikes, and deep golden eyes.

The guardian of the Frost Palace, exudes a regal air, yet beneath her icy exterior is a complex personality. Prideful and possessive, she takes her duty seriously. With a demeanor reminiscent of her brother Veldora, she can be childish. But has careful consideration of her actions as the strongest True Dragon since Veldanava’s disappearance.

Despite her haughty nature, Velzard harbors a sense of right and wrong, she often conceals her true feelings beneath a facade of grace and politeness. Reserving informality for Guy alone, whom she secretly loves.
cardPool.description:
Human Form

Velzard generally assumes a child-like appearance for the purpose of leaking her aura to keep the surroundings of the Frost Palace frozen and gridlocked. She appears no older than a girl in high school, with fair skin, eyes the color of Blue Diamonds ｢深海色の瞳ブルーダイアモンド, burū daiamondo｣, and long, Glossy Pearl-White hair tied into twin-tails reaching her waist. Most notably, her facial features are reminiscent of her niece, Milim Nava. Her attire consists of an off-shoulder white and blue dress and blue boots. She also wears detached white sleeves, a blue star-shaped pendant and a gold headband.

When Velzard gets serious in battle, her human form takes on a more mature look. The stark contrast from her usual appearance include her taking on gold eyes along with a pronounced voluptuous figure. She wears a two toned black and white dress, exposing a generous portion of cleavage. The dress has a slit by her left thigh, revealing her legs which she wears black tights over. She also wears long blue gloves and white heels, both adorned with gold.

Dragon Form

Her dragon form is covered in snow white scales with black spikes covering her back. Her eyes are deep golden and the same color as the large scale covering the top of her head. On each side of her forehead is a white forward facing horn. Her jaw is black and her mouth is covered in red teeth.

Personality

Velzard is a prideful, haughty, and excessively possessive person. She is also childish and capricious, much like her younger brother Veldora, but with some semblance of right and wrong and a careful consideration for the impact her actions can have on the world as a member of the strongest race. Furthermore, unlike Veldora, she does not openly show her feelings and conceals it beneath a polite and graceful exterior, only letting a glimpse of her true self slip out when overexcited. She refers to Guy's colleagues with formal honorifics, with Guy himself being the only exception.

Appears as a handsome man with black hair with streaks of red and gold, golden eyes with red pupils and black sclerae, finely dressed in garments like that of a prince.

Whimsical yet calculative, Diablo maintains absolute composure but turns coldly malicious towards those who insult Rimuru. However he treats those with a good relationship with Rimuru amiably, albeit with a tendency to manipulate for his own ends, often to be closer to Rimuru.

cardPool.title: Veldora
cardPool.value:
Veldora
Race: True Dragon
EV: 88,126,579

After being freed from his seal, Veldora learned to suppress his aura, appearing as a handsome, intimidating young man.
Veldora incarnated within one of his Body Doubles. He has blond hair, light-brown skin, his face is masculine although has similarities to Rimuru.

In dragon form, Veldora’s gigantic body is covered in black steel-like scales, with bluish wings and underside. His eyes shine a deep golden color, he sports four horns extending backward from the back of his head.

Veldora is boisterous, excitable, and easygoing, but prideful and energetic. He has a penchant for showing off his strength and boasts about his greatness, although he can be socially awkward and shy. Despite his intimidating reputation, Veldora is largely harmless unless provoked or if his loved ones are threatened.

He is bestfriends with Rimuru, and fears his older sisters, Velzard and Velgrynd. He loves anime, manga and will do practically anything for tasty food.
cardPool.description:
After being released from Rimuru's Stomach, Veldora was gifted one of his Body Doubles as a vessel to incarnate within, which Veldora reshaped to his liking. He has Blond hair, and is over two meters tall. Veldora's alterations to the body turned the face masculine, though Rimuru's general facial features remained. As Veldora learned to suppress his tremendous aura before leaving the Sealed Cave, he appears to most people as merely a handsome, albeit slightly intimidating, young man.

Dragon Form

His gigantic body is covered in black steel like scales, with his wings and underside taking on a bluish color. His eyes are deep golden and the back of his head is covered with four horns extending backwards.

Personality

Veldora is generally boisterous, excitable, but also fairly easy going. Despite his reputation as a rampaging idiot, Veldora is largely only dangerous if he doesn't get to unwind once in a while or if his loved ones are threatened. He is also quite energetic, prideful, and has no reservation in showing off his strength. Veldora is rather shy and socially awkward but hides it behind boasts of how "great" he is. He also has no social tact, seeming to not understand a simple request from him is enough to intimidate anyone into compliance regardless of their own personal feelings. Aside from his childish nature, he is quite knowledgeable about many things and has an unquenchable curiosity at his core. Veldora tends to act meek if things don't go his way, resulting in people wondering if Veldora is really as terrifying as the legends say.

cardPool.title: Magic Nullification
cardPool.value:
Magic Nullification, an Intrinsic Skill possessed by the True Giants, defies conventional understanding by negating magic, a feat previously thought impossible. This extraordinary ability is attributed to the Greater Giant Race, although it remains unclear whether it extends beyond the True Giants.

This skill operates by disrupting Spiritrons, effectively nullifying the effects of nearly all types of magic. It serves as an Anti-Magic Guard, rendering the user impervious to magical attacks while leaving them susceptible to purely physical assaults and certain emission-type attacks that operate on principles divergent from conventional magic, such as Nihility Magic.

Race: Hobgoblin

Lives in Capital City Tempest.

Gobta is a Hobgoblin originally from the goblin village saved by Rimuru Tempest. He resides in Capital City Tempest, the capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation.

Appearance

Despite evolving into a Hobgoblin, Gobta retains his physical appearance as a short Goblin child, which often surprises others.

Personality

Gobta is perceived as a fool but demonstrates remarkable competence when necessary. Despite his airheadedness, he exhibits unexpected brilliance, particularly in his role as the Goblin Riders’ captain. He is close friends and partners with Ranga, who he can fuse with to combine his skill with Ranga’s powers. Turning them into a terrifying, muscular werewolf creature. 

He is deeply loyal to his friends and exhibits traits of trust similar to Rimuru.

Special A (fully equipped)

Though he's considered a fool, he proves to be a very competent individual when the situation calls for it. His prowess on the battlefield surprises many. While he and Rimuru are detained in the Dwarf Kingdom, he sleeps through the entire imprisonment.[1] In the anime, during his fight with Gabiru, Rimuru wonders if Gobta isn't actually a prodigy of some sort.

cardPool.title: Primordial Demon Lore
cardPool.value:
Primordial Demons are the oldest and most powerful Demons, each identified by a signature color. Originating from the dawn of time, they emerged as Devil Lords from the Great Holy Spirit of Darkness. 

Led by Rouge, the Red Primordial, they ascended to rule the Demon Realm with unparalleled power. 

Rouge, now Guy Crimson,  resides in the Ice Continent as its ruler. 

Rain, the Blue Primordial, now Bleu, is loyal to Guy Crimson and resides in the Ice Continent alongside Vert, the Green Primordial, now Misery. 

Noir, the Black Primordial, known as Diablo

Blanc, the White Primordial, now Testarossa,

Violet, the Purple Primordial, known as Ultima, 

Jaune, the Yellow Primordial, now Carrera, all reside in the Jura Tempest Federation under Rimuru's guidance.

cardPool.description: Hinata Sakaguchi, leader of the Western Holy Church's Ten Great Saints, is a Japanese otherworlder and second in authority to the Holy Emperor. She has short black hair, violet eyes, and is described as stunningly beautiful. Usually clad in Holy Knights armor with a white coat draped over, she carries the Legend Grade rapier, Moonlight, gifted by Luminous personally.Hinata is a pragmatic leader, willing to cooperate for mankind's benefit, even with Demon Lords, despite the Church's anti-monster stance. She's harsh but efficient, reforming the Crusaders into a formidable force and establishing the Ten Great Saints. Her stubbornness, however, sometimes leads to deception, as seen when she fell for Rimuru's Body Double.Despite her headstrong nature, Hinata is willing to admit fault and make amends. Her dream is to create a peaceful world where humanity coexists harmoniously, driving her actions and decisions.

cardPool.description: Ultima, also known as Violet, is a cunning and calculative Daemon who serves Rimuru Tempest as the Chief Prosecutor in Tempest's legal department and leads the Black Numbers alongside Testarossa and Carrera. Recognized as one of Rimuru's Twelve Guardian Lords, she possesses a deceptive appearance of a cute and carefree princess, concealing her true nature as a sadistic and scheming individual.Her purple hair tied into a side ponytail complements her purple fingernails, reflecting her signature color. Ultima's attire varies from casual purple-colored dresses to a black skirted military uniform when she's serious. As a Demon, she possesses horns and wings, usually concealed, and can shapeshift her six bat-like wings as desired. Coerced by Noir, now Diablo, she reluctantly served until discovering Rimuru's worth, earning her the name "Ultima." Despite her sadistic tendencies, Ultima finds joy in observing and rewarding those who overcome adversity, showcasing a complex and personality.

cardPool.title: Temple Knights
cardPool.value:
The Temple Knights are the Knights adhered to Luminous Faith with duty to protect their Holy Land and other nations affilated with the church. Said to number in the tens of thousands, with ten thousand of them stationed in the Holy Land while the rest dispatched to other countries to spread the church's influence. They are the primary fighting force of The Holy Empire and vehemently worship their goddess Luminous. 

They are frequently stationed or sent to various areas and nations, tasked with the duty to hunt monsters with intense prejudice. 

Like the majority of the world they are unaware of Luminous Valentines’ status as a Demon Lord and Vampire, technically a monster. They continue manifesting powerful holy magic with their faith placed in her, unknowing that she is a monster.

	•	Ars: Luminary of Mars, specializing in Flame Arts.
	•	Salun: Luminary of Jupiter, known for Thunder Arts.

cardPool.title: Western Holy Church
cardPool.value:
The Western Holy Church, known for its Luminous Faith, is the dominant religious authority in the Western Nations, with the Holy Empire Ruberios as its recognized Holy Land and theocratic headquarters. 

They recognize one god, Luminous as the sole deity rejecting other gods existence.

It dispatches troops to eradicate rampaging monsters in regions where local rulers lack the means or interest to address them. 

dogma: monsters are evil and must be exterminated, leading to the formation of Temple Knights and Crusaders for monster slaying.

Established Temple Knights with assistance from nations under the Holy Emperor's protection.Disputes with Ruberios led to the Holy Emperor's Imperial Guards commanding the Temple Knights.

The addition of Crusaders has bolstered the Church's power, with selected cardinals holding the role of archon.

Guy Crimson
EV: 39,00,000
Race: Devil Lord
also known as Rouge, is the first of the Primordials and occupies the first seat of the Octagram, residing in the Ice Continent.
