cardPool.value:
Magic is producing effects based on concepts you fully understand. Mages use incantations and magicules to cast. Masters can cast without incantation. 

The only limit to magic in Tensura is the casters creativity, knowledge and the amount of magicules. Skilled mages can create a spell to accomplish nearly anything.

Primary Types:

	1.	Elemental Magic:
	2.	Holy Magic:
	3.	Spirit Magic:
	4.	Summoning Magic:

Many subtypes. 
Prominent subtypes:

	•	Dark Magic:
	•	Engraving Magic:
	•	Illusion Magic:
	•	Physics Magic:
	•	Soul Magic:
	Nuclear Magic and more.
cardPool.description:
Magic is producing effects based on specified laws. Mages use incantations, hand signs and magicules to cast. Prodigies can cast with mind.

Primary Types:

	1.	Elemental Magic: Controls magicules to bend nature’s laws, creating phenomena like fireballs, ice spears.
	2.	Holy Magic: Manipulates Holy Power and purifies magicules, effective against monsters and undead.
	3.	Spirit Magic: Borrows power from spirits, requiring no chants and usable by anyone connected to contracted elementals.
	4.	Summoning Magic: Summons beings from other realities, requiring mastery of spatial magic.

Many subtypes. 
Prominent subtypes:

	•	Dark Magic: Used by Daemons, includes Forbidden and Nihility Magic.
	•	Engraving Magic: “Enchants” people or objects.
	•	Illusion Magic: Manipulates spiritual bodies, causing sensory or direct damage.
	•	Physics Magic: Purely physical output bypassing anti-magic defenses.
	•	Soul Magic: Manipulates laws of the world concerning respective Elements.
	Nuclear Magic.

cardPool.title: Masayuki Honjou
cardPool.value:
Masayuki
Race: Divine Human
EV: 100,000,000 (dormant)

A reincarnation of Emperor Rudra, a key figure in history. 

Serving as the emperor of the Eastern Empire. Initially timid, Rudra evolved into an honorable and determined individual. Trained by Veldanava, he aimed to unite the world. 

During his adventures, including many duels with and eventual friendship with Guy Crimson, The Ultimate Skill: Michael, corrupted him over time. Scattering of his soul.

Velgrynd, his lover, played a crucial role in his story. she sought to gather Rudra's scattered soul fragments from various worlds. 

Eventually combining them into the body of Masayuki Honjou, a Japanese highschooler reincarnated into Tensura. How ever, his memories and power remained dormant, not remembering his life as Rudra. 

Retaining only his status as a Chosen Hero, the skill Chosen One, and faint memories of Velgrynd. Reverting to his timid personality, he is often shy around her as Velgrynd still treats him as her lover. 

When in danger, his true personality and powers manifest, reawakening his dormant memories and power.

cardPool.title: Rigurd
keys: Prime Minister of the Jura Tempest Federation
cardPool.value:
Rigurd serves as the Prime Minister of the Jura Tempest Federation and was Rimuru's first named subordinate. Originally a village chief of a Goblin Village, he evolved into a Hobgoblin upon being named. Rigurd is typically stoic but becomes overexcited when interacting with Rimuru. He has a natural charisma and diplomatic soundness, often organizing festivals and feasts and displaying emotional pride in his family. Despite facing challenges, Rigurd remains competent in his role as Prime Minister.

After evolving into a Hobgoblin, Rigurd gained a robust, muscular body, resembling that of a large adult human. He no longer needed his walking stick and could keep his eyes open with ease.

cardPool.value:
Ultimate Skill: True Hero - Lord of Heroes.

Banner of the Supreme King: Allows the user to call upon their fallen allies and replicate their abilities, memories, and experience inside the user.  (Can be used with parallel existence to create clones)

Multiplies existence value by at least 4, talented individuals may grow by up to 10 times. Masses adore you.

The counterparts to True Demon Lords, bestowed upon individuals blessed by an elemental of light or darkness.

Chosen Heroes can be initiated through what is known as a Chosen Hero’s Egg, where individuals receive the blessing of an Elemental of Light or Darkness, as well as the Elemental Queen. This egg is akin to the Demon Lord Seed, serving as the potential for their evolution.

The awakening of a Chosen Hero occurs when Elementals of Light or Darkness, along with the Elemental Queen, bless individuals they deem worthy. The respective Elemental resides within the individual as a Chosen Hero’s Egg until they prove themselves, at which point they merge with the awakened Chosen Hero.

Chosen Heroes are those who have merged with their elemental and become fully awakened. They are the equivalent of True Demon Lords, possessing immense power.

cardPool.title: Mollie (Gard Mjöllmile)
cardPool.value:
Mollie (Gard Mjöllmile)
Race: Human
Appearance:
Gard Mjöllmile known as Mollie has a plump physique and a modest stature, with a distinctive handlebar mustache and neatly trimmed goatee. A streak of striking yellow hair adds eccentricity to his appearance. Since leading the Four Nations Trade Alliance, he favors impeccably tailored suits that enhance his authoritative aura.

Personality:
Mollie’s extensive experience as a merchant allows him to connect with people effortlessly. Despite occasional crudeness, he displays shrewd business acumen and loyalty to those he trusts. He believes strongly in his luck and pursues ventures fearlessly, seeking mutual benefit in his endeavors.

Background:
As an orphan Mollie found joy in bringing smiles to his customers while selling vegetables. He rose to become a successful merchant, establishing shops in Blumund and Englassia. Joining Rimuru's team presented new opportunities, and he ensured his business thrived while venturing into Tempest.

cardPool.title: Hero Egg
cardPool.value:
Hero Egg, also known as “Chosen Hero,” are counterparts to Demon Lords, blessed by elementals of either light or darkness.

Hero Egg’s go beyond the typical magicule limit for a race. Heroes start with an additional EV of 777,777. 

Hero as a Class

	•	Hero’s Egg: Refers to individuals blessed by an Elemental of Light or Darkness, akin to the demon lord seed.
	•	Awakening: Elementals, along with the Elemental Queen, bless individuals they deem worthy, residing within them as a Chosen Hero’s Egg until merging with the awakened True Chosen Hero.
	•	True Hero: Those who merge with their elemental, becoming True Heroes, akin to True Demon Lords.

If the player selects the Hero Egg class, they are automatically chosen as a Hero’s Egg at birth. The player is already chosen by an elemental but has not fused with it. 

This can happen during a fierce or heroic battle or by training. Fusing completes the transformation from Heroes Egg to True Hero. Multiplying their power many times over.
cardPool.description:
Hero Egg, also known as “Chosen Heroes,” are counterparts to Demon Lords, blessed by elementals of either light or darkness. They have massive amounts of dormant potential and are destined to wield great power. 

Heroes are legendary figures chosen by the spirits to stand against great evils. Skilled warriors proficient in combat, they wield legendary weapons and artifacts to restore peace. Heroes inspire hope and admiration, leading by example to inspire others.

cardPool.title: The Eastern Empire
cardPool.value:
Northeast of the Jura Forest and east of the Great Canaat Mountains, the Eastern Empire encompasses the Imperial Capital Nasca and boasts a population of over 800 million.

Dating back thousands of years under the reign of Emperor Rudra , it grew into the dominant military power of the world, absorbing neighboring kingdoms and enforcing absolute authority.
Secretly, Rudra also commands the love of and loyalty of Velgrynd. 

Operates under absolute authoritarian control, with the emperor wielding both political and military dominance. The political department, comprised of nobles organized into the House of Peers, serves as a facade for the emperor’s absolute rule.

The empire’s expansionist agenda and aggressive tactics have led to strained relations with neighboring nations.
Particularly Dwargon and Tempest.

cardPool.title: Golden City El Dorado
cardPool.value:
Golden City El Dorado
Founder & Ruler: Leon Cromwell Location: Southwest Continent Population: 20,000,000
Chief Managers: Alrose, Claude

Overview: El Dorado is a vast country ruled by Demon Lord Leon Cromwell, situated on a continent larger than Australia on Earth. The city is divided into districts, each protected by a magic circle, offering a serene environment amidst nature. The capital, adorned with magnificent buildings, lies adjacent to an active volcano, shielded from volcanic ash and smoke by magical barriers and winds.

Economy: El Dorado thrives on its natural reserves of precious metals extracted from the earth by the central volcano. The nation’s economy heavily relies on mining, with gold, silver, and platinum being among the metals extracted. Some gold is discreetly traded with Sarion via private Dragon Airships in exchange for goods not locally produced.

Residents:
Leon’s royal guard. Knights who are in color coded armor, akin to Power Rangers.

cardPool.title: Kingdom of Farmenas
cardPool.value:
Kingdom of Farmenas
Leader: King Youm Farmenas

Established post-fall of Falmuth, Farmenas is a puppet state under Demon Lord Rimuru's influence.

**Background:**
Youm's ascension to the throne, backed by prominent nobles and support from Tempest, solidified Farmenas's status as a vassal state. Renamed from Falmuth, it now answers to Youm Farmenas.

**Government:**
Retaining Falmuth's governance structure, Farmenas relies on advisors like Edmaris and Edgar for Youm's rule. While a vassal of Tempest, it maintains some autonomy in governance, led by Chief Sorcerer Razen and Queen Mjur Farmenas.

**Economy:**
With a dwindling economy, Farmenas focuses on agriculture for revenue, aided by loans from Tempest. Investments in a "Magic Train" aim to rejuvenate the economy, with plans for a central station to bolster trade and logistics.

Military: Weak/Eliminated

Residents:
Mjurran (Queen)
Mieme (princess)
Grucius (Youm’s best friend, Lycanthrope wolf)
Razen (Sorcerer, Diablo’s subordinate)

cardPool.title: Kingdom of Ingrassia
cardPool.value:
West of the Jura Forest, the Kingdom of Ingrassia stands as a beacon of prosperity and influence in the region, boasting rich trade, culture, and politics. The go-to destination for those seeking fame or fortune. 

Overview

Ingrassia’s capital, a meticulously planned cityscape, is encased within imposing walls, with access regulated through stringent security measures. The city’s skyline is dominated by towering structures, housing a bustling populace engaged in various activities. At its heart lies a majestic castle surrounded by a serene lake, a symbol of the kingdom’s military prowess and strategic importance. Divided into four distinct districts, each with its own character and purpose, the city exudes a vibrant energy, teeming with life and activity.

Trade
Renowned for its wine production, Ingrassia’s vineyards yield exquisite vintages that are sought after far and wide. While the kingdom also dabbles in beer production, it has yet to match the acclaim of its wine industry.

Demon Lord Seed refers to individuals who have met the necessary qualifications to be able to undergo the Harvest Festival and become True Demon Lords.

True Demon Lord:
True Demon Lord sometimes referred to as Awakened Demon Lord, are those who have undergone the Harvest Festival and become actual Demon Lords.

The Octagram, also known as the Eight-Star Demon Lords, is a group of exceptionally powerful beings in Tensura. They are the 8 recognized True Demon Lords:

Guy Crimson (Head)
Milim Nava
Ramiris

cardPool.description:
Demon Lord is a term used in two different fashions, either as a classification for monsters or as a social position. In general, it refers to the strongest or highest-ranking among monsters, however, that is not an absolute rule.

Demon Lord Seed:
Demon Lord Seed refers to individuals who have met the necessary qualifications to be able to undergo the Harvest Festival and become Demon Lords. In terms of pure magicules alone, they are at least Special A, with an EP of at least 200,000 being required as one of the qualifications.

True Demon Lord:
True Demon Lord sometimes referred to as Awakened Demon Lord is a term created to distinguish those who call themselves a Demon Lord and those who have undergone the Harvest Festival and become actual Demon Lords.

Harvest Festival:
The Harvest Festival occurs once all the requirements to become a Demon Lord are met by a Demon Lord Seed. The World Language will confirm the user's intent to become a Demon Lord and the "initiation" will start.

cardPool.title: Harvest Festival
cardPool.value:
The Harvest Festival marks the beginning stage of evolution into a True Demon Lord, triggered once a Demon Lord Seed meets all requirements.

Requirements:
User most reach atleast 200,000 EP. 
User must acquire 10,000 souls. 
(If the User does not meet the EP requirement, they can use 100,000 souls instead)

Once the Harvest Festival initiates, the user becomes a True Demon Lord. This evolves them into their ultimate form and multiples EP. Typically awakening Ultimate Skills.

The completion of the Harvest Festival grants Gifts to all subordinates connected to the new True Demon Lord, fulfilling their desires. These Gifts vary, ranging from evolution to acquiring skills.
cardPool.description:
The Harvest Festival marks the evolution into a True Demon Lord, triggered once all requirements are met. To become a Demon Lord, one must fulfill specific conditions, becoming a Demon Lord Seed. This entails germinating the seed with a substantial number of souls, typically 10,000 souls. 

Upon germination, the Harvest Festival initiates, subjecting the candidate to a three-day initiation. During this period, the candidate undergoes a transformative process, resulting in a Super Evolution, acquiring potent Intrinsic Skills, and potentially experiencing minor personality changes. The power gained is immense, often elevating individuals to super-high level existences with increased odds of awakening Ultimate Skills.

The completion of the Harvest Festival grants Gifts to all connected to the new Demon Lord, fulfilling their desires. These Gifts vary, ranging from acquiring desired skills or evolutions to potentially awakening Unique Skills.

cardPool.title: True Demon Lord
cardPool.value:
True Demon Lord:
A Super Evolution obtainable by any race. Multiplies existence value by atleast 4, talented individuals may grow by up to 10 times.

This process causes the user to evolve into the ultimate form of their race (An insect would transform into a divine insect)


During the Harvest Festival initiation, Users begin to transform resulting in their Super Evolution into a desired form and acquiring powerful Intrinsic Skills. Their minds are stimulated, potentially leading to minor personality changes. 

True Demon Lords often reach divinity, making them super-high level existences, awakening Ultimate Skills. Additionally, all equipment reaches God Grade or near God Grade.
